contentBody: **A sheet column stays empty with Map Automatically. What is the likely cause?**
option.1: The sheet has too many rows for n8n to handle
option.2: The form has too few fields to fill the sheet
option.3: Field names don't exactly match the column headers
option.4: n8n is currently offline for everyone in the class
answerExplanation: Automatic mapping matches by name, with no error when a name differs.
